messages:
maya: kicking off a fractional nudge for rwd-infer v2.4.0 -> 15% (eu, us). change window til 22:00 UTC. watch: eu-west 5xx, embed similarity, p95 tail. stop criteria: eu 5xx > 0.5% sustained 5m OR p95 +120ms for 5m. keep chatter light, ops oncall pls ack.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started job=job-9921 target=15% version=v2.4.0 regions=[eu,us] dashboard=https://dash.redwood.internal/rollouts/job-9921 actions: /deploy pause job-9921 | /deploy abort job-9921 | /deploy rollback job-9921 --to v2.3.3

leo: seeing a tiny blip in eu-west 500s to 0.42% 1m ago, nothing alarming yet. traces show a tokenization fallback in some spans.

ada: noted. tailing logs and rerunning a couple of failing sample prompts locally against the canary.

maya: holding further expansion. pausing preemptively until we validate tokenization path. @deploy-bot pause job-9921

deploy-bot: job-9921 paused by maya (manual). traffic remains at 15%. rollback cmd cached: /deploy rollback job-9921 --to v2.3.3

sre-team: infra signals green (no host OOMs, cpu/gpu normal). p95 delta +22ms. error-rate correlates with tokenizer warn spikes. recommend pinning tokenizer for canary cohorts or a quick hotfix.

leo: creating hotfix branch now: hotfix/tokenizer-compat-v2.4.0 -> will try pin v1.9 in canary. ETA 12m to validate.

maya: add ops-runbook note and slack alert text for support. we want clear comms if we roll back (incl. customer impact note).

ops-bot: ops note added: "v2.4.0 canary: tokenizer fallback observed; hold at 15% until hotfix validated. rollback plan: rollback to v2.3.3 if eu 5xx >0.5% for 5m. See playbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/playbooks/tokenizer-rollback"

ada: quick local tests look good with pinned tokenizer v1.9. preparing canary patch to redeploy into the paused cohort once approved.

leo: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infer/PR-1587 "hotfix: pin tokenizer v1.9 for staged cohorts" includes smoke tests and rollback steps.

maya: acks? we'll resume to 30% only after hotfix patch passes canary recheck. also note: if we rollback we'll cut a follow-up ticket to trigger a postmortem.

ada: ack 0 monitoring and smoke tests.

leo: ack 0 will merge on green and coordinate a controlled resume.

deploy-bot: snapshot: eu 5xx=0.45%, us 5xx=0.02%, p95 delta=+21ms. paused. awaiting hotfix and manual resume/rollback.

maya: thanks team. will wait for PR + 15m of stable metrics before a go. calling end-of-hold in 15m for a go/no-go decision.
